explanation: Map each distinct value to its inorder position. Each preorder range’s first value is its root; its inorder position determines the corresponding left and right traversal ranges. Recursively build those ranges.
spaceComplexity: O(n) inorder index map and O(h) recursion space, plus output nodes.
